newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade slow.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade slow.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices held their ground in late trading despite tight domestic supply and gains in Malaysia, traders said on Thursday.
They said olein was around 1,460-65 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but some players were heard quoting 1,470 rupiah. October delivery olein was around 1,435-40 rupiah.
The traders said crude palm oil was hovering at the 1,205-rupiah level in Medan.
"There have been all sorts of explanations for the tight supply such as high exports, lower than expected output in some areas and some players' positions," one trader said.
Another trader said there was market talk that palm oil production in some growing areas were below expectations.
"There has also been talk that exports had been high when overseas' prices were attractive and sellers were currently meeting their export commitments," he said.
A trader said the government would like local olein prices to hover at the 1,400-1,450 rupiah/kg level, but added that it would be a difficult target in view of the tight supply.
